106484 / 106484S: Cortech Sentinel Arm Chair
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-106484-sentinel-arm-chair
Manufacturer page: https://cortechusa.com/products/furniture/seating/sentinel-arm-chair/
Spec sheets: 106484, Installation
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech Sentinel Arm Chair – 106484 / 106484S
Current H1: Cortech Sentinel - Chair with Dual Arm-Rests - One-Piece Rotationally Molded Design - Model 106484
Subtitle: One-Piece Molded Arm Chair That Stands Alone or Bolts Together, with an Optional Ballast Door
Current subtitle: Cortech USA 106484 Sentinel Arm Chair for Individual and Group Seating
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech Sentinel Arm Chair is a molded arm chair for dayrooms, waiting areas, and group spaces in behavioral healthcare and correctional facilities. It can stand alone or be bolted to other Sentinel chairs for group seating, and its molded arms give users support.
The chair is rotationally molded in one piece from high impact “no break” polyethylene, with no steel or wood components. It can be bolted to the floor through concealed pilot holes, and the 106484S has a ballast door for adding sandbags on site. The Sentinel is rated for outdoor use.
Material: One-piece rotationally molded high impact “no break” polyethylene; no steel or wood components
Dimensions: 24”W×24”D×33”H
Weight: 35 lbs
Ganging: Can be bolted together with other Sentinel chairs for group seating
Floor Mounting: Can be bolted to the floor through concealed pilot holes
Ballast Door: The 106484S has a ballast door for adding sandbags on site; it closes with tamper-resistant screws. Do not use loose sand
Outdoor Use: Rated for outdoor use and UV stabilized
Antimicrobial Testing: Tested to ISO 22196, showing a greater than 99% reduction in bacteria
Flammability Standards: Flame retardant; passes California Technical Bulletin 133 and UL 94 HB
Environmental Certification: GREENGUARD Gold
Easy Cleaning: Sound dampening, and easy to clean, sanitize, and maintain
Colors: Aqua, Black, Blue Gray, Brown, Burgundy, Canvas, Claylight, Gray, Green, Indigo, Midnight Blue, Moss, Overcast, Sand, Seagrass, Slate Blue, Stone Gray, or Tide (custom colors available on request)
Warranty: Lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards
Available Models and Options
106484 – Standard: Without access door
106484S – With Access Door: Ballast door for adding sandbags on site
Installation and Options
Floor Mounting: Bolt to the floor through concealed pilot holes with 3/8”-16×3¾” security Torx anchor bolts and flat washers; see Cortech instructions. Hardware not included
Ganging: Bolt chairs together with 3/8”-16×2½” security Torx bolts and flat washers; see Cortech instructions. Hardware not included
Ballast Door: Hardware bit size is T27
[H2] Applications
The Sentinel Arm Chair suits waiting and group areas that need supportive seating that is hard to move or break.
Typical applications include:
Dayrooms, lounges, and waiting areas in behavioral healthcare facilities and psychiatric hospitals
Dayrooms, visitation rooms, and common areas in correctional facilities and jails
Residential treatment centers and other group spaces
Explore Anchortex's Behavioral Healthcare Anti-Ligature Furniture and Prison and Detention Furniture collections for more institutional furniture.
[H2] About Cortech Seating
Cortech seating is molded for dayrooms, lounges, dining areas, and patient rooms in behavioral healthcare and correctional facilities, where chairs are used hard every day and must be difficult to break or tamper with.
Cortech seating includes:
Stacking Chairs: The Razorback injection molded stack chair
Lounge and Group Seating: The Sabre Lounge Chair and the Sentinel Arm and Armless Chairs, which stand alone or bolt together
Rocking Chairs: The Radial Rocker
Summit Series: Guest chairs, accent chairs, lounge chairs, and stools, with an optional Veldura soft-touch finish
Endurance Series: Crew chairs, benches, and floor mounted stools
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (58 characters): Cortech Sentinel Arm Chair - 106484 / 106484S at Anchortex
Meta description (156 characters): Shop the Cortech Sentinel Arm Chair. A one-piece molded arm chair that stands alone or bolts together, with an optional ballast door, rated for outdoor use.
Notes and Questions
Series section: "About Cortech Seating" is a new section for the Razorback, Sabre, Sentinel, and Radial Rocker pages. It is the same on each of these pages.
H1: Cortech calls it the Sentinel Arm Chair. I took out "Chair with Dual Arm-Rests," "One-Piece Rotationally Molded Design," and "Model," and added the 106484S.
Weight: your variant is set to 40 lbs. The Cortech spec sheet says 35 lbs, so I used 35 lbs.
Warranty: your current page says 10-year warranty. The Cortech spec sheet says lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects, so I used that.
Colors: your current page lists 12 colors. The Cortech spec sheet lists 18, so I used the Cortech list.
Static load: the Cortech spec sheet says 1,500 lb static load on the first page and +750 lbs on the second page, so I left it out.
Installation hardware: the bolt sizes come from the Cortech installation instructions. The bit size (T27) comes from the spec sheet.
GREENGUARD Gold: this comes from the Cortech web page. The spec sheet does not mention it.
Outdoor use: the FAQ on the Cortech product page says the Sentinel Arm Chair is rated for outdoor use and UV stabilized, so I added it to the description.
Product images: the page has five images. The last one is the older Cortech color chart with 12 colors. The Cortech product page has photos of this chair in all 18 colors. Would you like me to add them, and replace the chart with the 18-color chart?
